Name: (CP) Army of Jimothy - Raccoon Livestock Add-On
Author: kirbysteaks
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]“What am I looking at??”
It’s just Jimothy. His spine may be a bit abnormal but he gets along just fine.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][img width=128]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49457/49457-1784592460-1106694007.gif[/img]

This mod adds Jimothy the raccoon as a farm animal purchasable from Marnie. Jimothy will mostly bring you trash and seeds, but if you take good care of him, he may bring you Treasure or an Artifact Trove. 

By default, Jimothy lives in barns. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]ExtraAnimalConfigs [/url]is recommended if you want him to be able to fit in coops or want to remove item quality from his drops so they stack nicely. 

[b]Additional install info:[/b]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Patcher[/url]. 
For 1.6+.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Should be very safe to install on an existing save but may cause oddities if uninstalled mid-game. I recommend selling all Jimothys you own before trying to uninstall. Generally, Stardew is fairly robust in handling mods, so it's hard to *break* a save, especially with content pack mods like this that don't edit save data. If you remove a mod for an item or animal while still having it in game, it'll usually just show up with a red '[/color][color=#cc0000]🛇[/color][color=#D4D4D8]' texture and a name of '???'.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]If using in multiplayer, it is recommended that all players have the same version of the mod installed. [/color]
[img width=130]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49457/49457-1784596167-211768028.gif[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Future update hopes?:[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Add baby Jimothy sprite[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Add Jimothy pet support[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
Jimothy’s sprites were made based on the raccoon sprites included in the vanilla game. No AI was used anywhere in the making of this mod, including it's code and assets.[/color]

Shout out to the modding community in the SDV discord for being great at answering questions and offering support. 

[size=4][b]New to modding?[/b][/size]
[size=3]Learn how to install mods from the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Stardew Valley Wiki[/url]. Once you install SMAPI, most mods (including this one) are as easy as dropping a folder into your mods folder. Stardew is one of the easiest games to add mods to.[/size]
